newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann plans to close plant -Bild.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann plans to close plant -Bild.

text.p: Mannesmann AG plans to close a steel-tube plant in the rust-belt west German state of Saarland, the Bild newspaper reported on Thursday.
The tabloid quoted works council member Joachim Eisenbarth as saying the plant's 900 workers would be told on Thursday.
A Mannesmann spokesman said he was unaware of any plan to close the Bous plant. "We will have to wait and see," he said.
Bild said the engineering conglomerate's tubes alliance with France's Vallourec SA, announced on February 10, made its plant in Bous redundant.
The newspaper quoted a Mannesmann spokesman as saying overcapacity must be reduced.
